stages.prompt:
The café staff have declared addition beneath them. Total the tab. The first line contains the item count N (0 to 100). The second line contains exactly N integer prices in cents (each 0 to 10000), separated by single spaces. The second line is empty when N is 0. Print the total as one base-10 integer on its own line, followed by a newline. Use integers throughout.

Example 1 input:
3
125 250 50
Example 1 output:
425
stages.reference_solution:
item_count = int(input())
prices = list(map(int, input().split()))
print(sum(prices))

stages.prompt:
The diners have decided fairness is your problem. Keep totaling the tab, then split it by seat. The first line contains the item count N (0 to 100). The second line contains exactly N integer prices in cents (each 0 to 10000), separated by single spaces. The second line is empty when N is 0. A new third line gives the number of diners P (1 to 20). Print exactly P base-10 integer shares in cents, in seat order starting at seat 1, on a single line separated by single spaces and followed by a newline. Give each diner the whole-number quotient of the total divided by P, then add one cent to each of the first total modulo P seats. Use integers throughout.

Example 1 input:
3
125 250 50
3
Example 1 output:
142 142 141

Example 2 input:
0

2
Example 2 output:
0 0
stages.reference_solution:
item_count = int(input())
prices = list(map(int, input().split()))
diners = int(input())
share, remainder = divmod(sum(prices), diners)
print(*(share + (seat < remainder) for seat in range(diners)))
